title: the page loads and the spec reads the API

findings.summary: the spec called an origin this run was not granted
findings.detail:
This run was granted http://127.0.0.1:55357, and the spec made calls from Node to an origin it was never given:
  http://127.0.0.1:55364 — 1 call via fetch (pid 91248, cwd /private/var/folders/lx/2ys8sqh90gb3dhpjvnv5wtc40000gn/T/serving-fixture-proof-W8hrL7/foreign-checkout, which reports itself on port 55364)
Those calls did not reach the fixture this artifact names. If the other end is another lane's fixture, this journey has just read — and possibly written — a world it did not build, and the result says nothing about this checkout. A base URL that ignores `E2E_FIXTURE_PORT` is how this happens; see test/e2e/journeys/meals-statement-month.spec.js and its sibling specs for the expression that honours it.
